subject: general
question:
The value of 

3 ÷ 1 – 2 + 3 is:
solution:
**Given:**

3 ÷ (1 – 2 + 3)

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6dff4d58ce66b38e0cdda1b0a721fa32c2ef301f704e653b2f493673a6e332b.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ 3 ÷ 1 – 2 + 3

⇒ 3 + 1

⇒ 4

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
